text: dsh-req-capture 是一个 DSH 插件，用于调试宿主发出的网络请求。它在插件应用时包装全局 fetch，为每次调用记录时间、方法、截断后的 URL 和请求体大小；设置 URL 匹配子串后，还会把符合条件的字符串请求体写成 JSON 文件。日志和捕获文件保存在可配置目录，默认是 /tmp/dsh-req-capture。插件通过 profile bundle patch 插入，没有界面或注册工具，适合排查请求内容和比较请求载荷。可通过 REQ_CAPTURE_DIR 和 REQ_CAPTURE_MATCH 配置输出位置与筛选条件，不需要额外 API Key 或账号。

dsh-req-capture logs DSH fetch calls with time, method, truncated URL, and body size. Configure a URL substring to save matching string bodies as JSON files. Output uses REQ_CAPTURE_DIR (default /tmp/dsh-req-capture); REQ_CAPTURE_MATCH sets the filter. Install through a profile bundle patch.
我想看看 DSH 发出的 fetch 请求都去了哪里。
能不能把匹配某个网址的请求体保存下来方便排查？
How can I inspect request methods and body sizes during DSH debugging?
dsh-req-capture 的功能「记录 fetch 调用」：插件应用后包装宿主全局 fetch，为每次请求追加时间、方法、截断 URL 和请求体大小到 fetch-log.txt。它自动运行，无需命令或按钮。
dsh-req-capture 的功能「筛选并保存请求体」：设置 REQ_CAPTURE_MATCH 为 URL 子串后，匹配且请求体为字符串的请求会另存为带时间和序号的 JSON 文件。插件在 fetch 调用时自动判断并保存。

dsh-req-capture README · dsh-req-capture：Diagnostic plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It wraps the host's global `fetch` to log outgoing requests and capture matching request bodies to disk for offline analysis (for example, diffing LLM request payloads when debugging cache-hit differences).

No UI, no tools.

dsh-req-capture README · Configuration：| env | meaning | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `REQ_CAPTURE_MATCH` | URL substring; bodies of requests whose URL contains it are written to the capture dir | empty (capture nothing, log only) |
| `REQ_CAPTURE_DIR` | capture directory | `/tmp/dsh-req-capture` |

dsh-req-capture README · Configuration：Every fetch call is logged to `<dir>/fetch-log.txt` (timestamp, method, truncated URL, body size); matching bodies are written as `req-<ts>-<seq>.json`. A self-probe fetch runs once on apply to verify the wrapper is live in the host realm.

> **Warning** — captured bodies are raw request payloads and may contain prompt content. Treat the capture directory as sensitive and delete it when done.

dsh-req-capture README · Install：Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bundle stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.
